organization.name: Fin (formerly Intercom)
organization.notes: Founded as Intercom; renamed Fin in 2026. Salesforce completed acquisition September10,2026. Venture investors are historical; acquirer is parent, not conflated with venture funding.

pricingTiers.name: Essential
pricingTiers.notes: Annual-billed $29/seat/month multiplied by12. Fin from $0.99/outcome extra; channel usage additional. Monthly-billed amount not verified. Verified Fin usage starts at$0.99/outcome, separate from the per-seat subscription and other channel charges.
No explicitly highlighted Most popular or Recommended plan found in the public pricing page.

pricingTiers.name: Advanced
pricingTiers.notes: Closest growing-team plan. Annual-billed $85/seat/month multiplied by12, plus Fin outcomes and channel usage. Verified Fin usage starts at$0.99/outcome, separate from the per-seat subscription and other channel charges.

pricingTiers.name: Expert
pricingTiers.notes: Closest large-team security/multibrand plan; no separately named Enterprise price. Annual-billed $132/seat/month multiplied by12; usage extra. Verified Fin usage starts at$0.99/outcome, separate from the per-seat subscription and other channel charges.

moats.claim: Messenger, knowledge content, workflow automation and Fin form a connected support system with accumulated configuration switching costs.

productReasons.claim: Fin answers across customer channels and hands complex cases to the same shared inbox.
Visual workflows and round-robin assignment coordinate multiple support inboxes.
Private multilingual help centers and multibrand Messenger support segmented customer experiences.
